What it does

Built for real discipline.
Not just good intentions.

Every feature in CalmLock is designed to intervene in the exact moment of weakness - when habits are made or broken.

Focus Sessions

Set a duration from 15 minutes to custom hours. Once started, CalmLock locks you in. Switching tabs triggers an instant interruption screen.

Daily Streak System

Complete a focus session each day to grow your streak. Miss a day and it resets. The same psychology that makes Duolingo addictive, applied to focus.

Protection Layer

App blocking, content filtering, notification silencing, and strict mode - four toggles that build a wall between you and distraction during sessions.

Session Analytics

Track your longest streak, current streak, weekly focus goal progress, and full session history. Data that shows you the pattern, not just the number.

Dark Mode + Themes

CalmLock follows your system setting automatically, or toggle manually. Dark navy feels premium. Light mint feels calm. Both are intentional.

Daily Reminders

Set a daily notification time. CalmLock sends a streak-aware nudge — "5 days strong, don't break it" - that brings you back before the habit slips.
